trend_days.description: Insight rows with a call_date in [now - trend_days, now] count toward how often a theme comes up.

product_context.description: Optional: what the product does and for whom, so links are judged against the real product.

max_pains.description: How many top pains to report and link.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
